about: Sizes drawn by the size comparison tool (site/sections/tools.py). lo/hi/draw are in feet; dim is what was measured (height, length, wingspan, shoulder). basis says where the number comes from. left_out lists creatures the tool skips, with the reason shown on the page. icon_box is each icon's painted area in its 64-unit viewBox, so silhouettes stand on the ground line at the right scale.

bigfoot.basis: Witness reports often say 7 to 9 ft tall; weight guesses run 500 to 800 lb.

yeti.basis: Accounts run from child-sized to over 8 ft; most describe something about as tall as a person.
